demo_annular_snap.applications: Bottle-cap and filter-housing lids, pipe couplings, and round enclosure closures that snap together on a circumferential ridge.
demo_annular_snap.description: A circumferential ridge snapping into a groove: the cylindrical snap fit of bottle caps, filter housings, pipe couplings, and round enclosure lids, as unionable ridge and groove features.
demo_annular_snap.usecase: Bottle-cap and filter-housing lids, pipe couplings, and round enclosure closures that snap together on a circumferential ridge.

demo_arc_ratchet.applications: Tension-loaded one-way clutches, winch handles, and compact ratchets that use flexure arms instead of rigid pawls.
demo_arc_ratchet.description: Three trailing tension-loaded arc flexures engaging a self-energising undercut ring.

demo_archimedes_screw.applications: Irrigation and drainage lifts, bulk-material conveyors, and demonstration models of the classical water screw.
demo_archimedes_screw.description: A helical flight on a shaft inside a half-pipe trough, posed inclined; each turn carries one pocket of material uphill. Grain augers, snowblowers, and wastewater lift screws.
demo_archimedes_screw.doc: Inclined water screw: helical flight inside a half-pipe trough.
demo_archimedes_screw.usecase: Irrigation and drainage lifts, bulk-material conveyors, and demonstration models of the classical water screw.

demo_auxetic_panel.applications: Impact pads, expandable meshes, medical and sports structures that widen when stretched.
demo_auxetic_panel.description: A flat panel that gets WIDER, not narrower, when you stretch it: its internal cell topology supplies a negative Poisson's ratio instead of the base plastic. Three interchangeable cell types (reentrant bowtie honeycomb, rigid rotating squares on corner hinges, and a chiral node-and-tangent-ligament grid) trade off stiffness, hinge fatigue life, and print complexity for the same auxetic effect.
demo_auxetic_panel.usecase: Impact pads, expandable meshes, medical and sports structures that widen when stretched.

demo_ball_socket_joint.applications: Control arms, camera gimbals, robotic wrists, and snap-together spherical joints for multi-axis motion.
demo_ball_socket_joint.description: A ball on a stem snaps into a split-finger socket whose mouth is pinched narrower than the ball, so the lip wraps past the equator and holds it: three rotational degrees of freedom inside a cone limited by the stem hitting the mouth rim. The tie-rod end and camera-mount joint, printed as two parts that click together.
demo_ball_socket_joint.usecase: Control arms, camera gimbals, robotic wrists, and snap-together spherical joints for multi-axis motion.

demo_barrel_cam.applications: Fishing-reel level winds, tool-changer drums, textile traverse mechanisms, and cylindrical groove cams for axial programs.
demo_barrel_cam.description: A barrel cam whose closed groove follows a motion-law z(theta) program around the drum, with a mating follower pin and guide. Winds the level line of a fishing reel or drives a toolchanger drum.
demo_barrel_cam.usecase: Fishing-reel level winds, tool-changer drums, textile traverse mechanisms, and cylindrical groove cams for axial programs.

demo_beam_coupling.applications: 3D-printer Z axes, CNC builds, and motor-to-leadscrew links that need one cheap part forgiving angular, parallel, and axial misalignment.
demo_beam_coupling.description: A helical-slit flexible coupling: torsionally stiff yet compliant in angular, parallel, and axial misalignment. The standard printed coupling of 3D-printer Z axes and CNC builds.
demo_beam_coupling.usecase: 3D-printer Z axes, CNC builds, and motor-to-leadscrew links that need one cheap part forgiving angular, parallel, and axial misalignment.

demo_bearing_seat.applications: 608 and similar skate-bearing pockets in robots, printers, and rollers that need a retained race.
demo_bearing_seat.description: A cut-away retained 608 seat with a bearing reference ring.
demo_bearing_seat.usecase: 608 and similar skate-bearing pockets in robots, printers, and rollers that need a retained race.

demo_bell_crank.applications: Brake and clutch pedals, throttle and shift linkages, print-bed levellers, and any force redirect through a fixed angle.
demo_bell_crank.description: A two-arm lever on a ground pivot that redirects force through a fixed included angle (default 90 degrees). The simplest force redirector in mechanical design: brake pedals, throttle links, and print-bed levellers all use one.
demo_bell_crank.usecase: Brake and clutch pedals, throttle and shift linkages, print-bed levellers, and any force redirect through a fixed angle.

demo_belleville_washer.applications: Bolted-joint preload, clutch packs, and high-load short-stroke stacks of disc springs.
demo_belleville_washer.description: A coned annular disc spring, shown as a three-disc series stack with the cone direction alternating. Disc springs give the most force per unit volume of any printable spring, and above a free-cone-height to thickness ratio of sqrt(2) they snap through instead of resisting smoothly; the flag is derived from the geometry and stored in metadata.
demo_belleville_washer.usecase: Bolted-joint preload, clutch packs, and high-load short-stroke stacks of disc springs.

demo_bellows_suction_cup.applications: TPU pick-and-place end effectors and vacuum handling of smooth parts, with a hose-barb stem for the vacuum line.
demo_bellows_suction_cup.description: A bellows vacuum cup for TPU pick-and-place: a thin sealing lip, compliant folds, and a hose-barb stem for the vacuum line, with collapsed height and cup volume in the metadata.
demo_bellows_suction_cup.usecase: TPU pick-and-place end effectors and vacuum handling of smooth parts, with a hose-barb stem for the vacuum line.

demo_belt_tensioner.applications: Automatic belt tensioners on engines and printers, compliant arms that keep constant belt load as the belt stretches.
demo_belt_tensioner.description: A curved cantilever spring arm printed as one part: its tip is pushed back a set preload distance when mounted against the belt, so it keeps the idler loaded against the belt line with no metal spring and re-deflects as the belt stretches. Peak bending strain is checked against a PLA/PETG limit at build time.
demo_belt_tensioner.usecase: Automatic belt tensioners on engines and printers, compliant arms that keep constant belt load as the belt stretches.

demo_bevel_gear_pair.applications: Differentials, hand drills, right-angle gearboxes, and any intersecting-axis mesh at 90 degrees.
demo_bevel_gear_pair.description: A straight bevel pair on 90-degree axes, the involute profile lofted toward the pitch apex in the Tredgold approximation. Right-angle drives of hand drills, angle grinders, and differentials.
demo_bevel_gear_pair.doc: Straight bevel pair posed meshed on perpendicular axes.
demo_bevel_gear_pair.usecase: Differentials, hand drills, right-angle gearboxes, and any intersecting-axis mesh at 90 degrees.

demo_bistable_beam.applications: Snap switches, tactile buttons, and mechanisms that click between two stable positions.
demo_bistable_beam.description: A flat-printed buckled-beam bistable switch: pre-curved cosine beams clamped in a frame carry a central shuttle that snaps between two stable positions. Used for clicky toggle latches, haptic buttons and one-piece switches.
demo_bistable_beam.usecase: Snap switches, tactile buttons, and mechanisms that click between two stable positions.

demo_board_cradle.applications: PCB mounting in instruments and printers: corner standoffs and capture walls around a board outline.
demo_board_cradle.description: Four PCB corner standoffs and capture walls around a 40 x 30 mm board.
demo_board_cradle.signature: demo_board_cradle(board_w: 'float' = 40.0, board_d: 'float' = 30.0, board_h: 'float' = 8.0, board_t: 'float' = 1.6, fl: 'float' = 0.0, standoff: 'float' = 4.0) -> 'MeshList'
demo_board_cradle.usecase: PCB mounting in instruments and printers: corner standoffs and capture walls around a board outline.

demo_boxc.applications: Blocks, spacers, and axis-aligned volumes that start most bracket and housing models.
demo_boxc.description: A box positioned by its center and XYZ extents.
demo_boxc.usecase: Blocks, spacers, and axis-aligned volumes that start most bracket and housing models.

demo_chain_dual_output.usecase: Jackshafts and conveyor lines needing simultaneous forward and reverse take-offs from one chain run: a sprocket inside the loop turns with the driver, an idler on the back of a span turns opposite.

demo_chain_reverse.usecase: Reverse-rotation takeoffs on conveyors, agricultural machinery, and machine drives: an idler sprocket bearing on the back of a chain span turns opposite to the driver.

demo_chain_s_wrap.usecase: S-wrap reversing drives on conveyors, mixers, and farm machinery: the chain snakes over the driver and around the outside of the driven sprocket, so the output shaft turns opposite without gears.

demo_chamfer_prism.applications: Enclosures with a soft top edge, control knobs, and prisms that need a clean hull chamfer.
demo_chamfer_prism.description: A rounded enclosure prism with a clean hull-chamfered top.
demo_chamfer_prism.usecase: Enclosures with a soft top edge, control knobs, and prisms that need a clean hull chamfer.

demo_chebyshev.applications: Straight-line walking and leg mechanisms, Russian school teaching models, and approximate linear guides with only revolute joints.
demo_chebyshev.description: Chebyshev's lambda four-bar: rockers of 5u on a ground of 4u joined by a coupler of 2u. The coupler midpoint holds an approximate straight line (error a few hundredths of the unit) over its working stroke. The Russian school's answer to Watt.

demo_check_valve.applications: Pump outlet lines, siphon breaks, and air lines that need one- way flow: a bought bearing ball on a conical seat.
demo_check_valve.description: A ball-check non-return valve built around a bought bearing ball on a conical seat, with a snap-on cap and hose-barb ports. Pump outlet lines, siphon breaks, and air lines.
demo_check_valve.usecase: Pump outlet lines, siphon breaks, and air lines that need one- way flow: a bought bearing ball on a conical seat.

demo_clamshell_shiplap.applications: Split enclosures, clamshell housings, and lid-to-base seams that interlock with a shiplap lip.
demo_clamshell_shiplap.description: The matching raised base lip and oversized lid receiver slot.
demo_clamshell_shiplap.usecase: Split enclosures, clamshell housings, and lid-to-base seams that interlock with a shiplap lip.

demo_clevis.applications: Actuator rod ends, turnbuckles, control links, and any pin joint that couples a fork to an eye.
demo_clevis.description: A U-fork, a pin, and an eye: the basic pin joint for linking a rod end to a lever or turnbuckle. Prints as three separate parts that assemble with the designed pin clearance.
demo_clevis.usecase: Actuator rod ends, turnbuckles, control links, and any pin joint that couples a fork to an eye.

demo_coil_spring.applications: Suspension and return springs, battery contacts, and general helical compression springs in machines.
demo_coil_spring.description: A helical compression spring swept along a cylinder, with one dead coil at each end closed up to a flat seat and a choice of round or rectangular wire. The pitch is bounded from below by the wire diameter plus a printable kerf, and the helix angle by a self-support floor, so unprintable geometry raises rather than slicing into a solid tube.
demo_coil_spring.usecase: Suspension and return springs, battery contacts, and general helical compression springs in machines.

demo_collet_chuck.applications: CNC spindle and router collets, lathe workholding, and any on-axis grip that must close concentrically on a round tool or stock.
demo_collet_chuck.description: An ER-style split collet with its taper nut and spindle nose. Slots cut alternately from each end turn the sleeve into a ring of fingers, and drawing its 8 degree cone into the matching cone in the nose squeezes them onto whatever is in the bore. Grips on axis, and closes as far as the slots can shut.
demo_collet_chuck.usecase: CNC spindle and router collets, lathe workholding, and any on-axis grip that must close concentrically on a round tool or stock.

demo_compliant_clutch.applications: Torque-limiting knobs, safety clutches on feeders, and printed drives that should slip before something breaks.
demo_compliant_clutch.description: Integral spiral flexures engaging an internal sawtooth race, shown with the torque-limit face fraction.

demo_counterbore.applications: Socket-head and pan-head screw seats, flush fastener pockets in plates and brackets.
demo_counterbore.description: A through-hole with a cylindrical recessed-head pocket.
demo_counterbore.usecase: Socket-head and pan-head screw seats, flush fastener pockets in plates and brackets.

demo_cross_flexure.applications: Precision instrument pivots, watch balances, and monolithic hinges that flex instead of using a pin.
demo_cross_flexure.description: A monolithic cross-axis flexural pivot: two rigid blocks joined only by two crossing thin blades, giving limited frictionless, backlash-free rotation about the crossing point. Used in precision instruments, optical mounts and printed robot joints.
demo_cross_flexure.usecase: Precision instrument pivots, watch balances, and monolithic hinges that flex instead of using a pin.

demo_crush_ribs.applications: Press-fit captures for PCBs, sensors, and rectangular inserts that should grip without glue.
demo_crush_ribs.description: Six tapered vertical ribs squeezing a rectangular component.
demo_crush_ribs.signature: demo_crush_ribs(comp_w: 'float' = 18.0, comp_d: 'float' = 12.0, comp_h: 'float' = 16.0, rib_t: 'float' = 0.6, count: 'int' = 3, interference: 'float' = 0.12, rib_h: 'float' = 10.0, rib_depth: 'float' = 6.0) -> 'MeshList'
demo_crush_ribs.usecase: Press-fit captures for PCBs, sensors, and rectangular inserts that should grip without glue.

demo_cycloidal_drive.applications: Robot joint reducers, cobot arms, and compact high-ratio drives where cycloidal geometry packs more torque than a planetary.
demo_cycloidal_drive.description: A single-stage cycloidal reducer: an eccentric input precesses a shortened-epitrochoid disc against a ring of housing pins, with output taken through oversized pin holes. The robot-joint reducer of Nabtesco RV and DIY actuators.
demo_cycloidal_drive.doc: Cycloidal reducer; default assembled so ANIMATE can orbit the disc.
demo_cycloidal_drive.usecase: Robot joint reducers, cobot arms, and compact high-ratio drives where cycloidal geometry packs more torque than a planetary.

demo_cyl.applications: Bosses, pins, rollers, and any cylindrical stock or cutter axis in a parametric assembly.
demo_cyl.description: A configurable cylinder oriented along any principal axis.
demo_cyl.usecase: Bosses, pins, rollers, and any cylindrical stock or cutter axis in a parametric assembly.

demo_dbore.applications: Double-D motor and pot shafts, keyed hubs, and sockets that must transmit torque without a set screw.
demo_dbore.description: A double-D socket blank beside a ready-made keyed hub.
demo_dbore.signature: demo_dbore(shaft_d: 'float' = 5.5, flat: 'float' = 3.7, hub_r: 'float' = 7.0, hub_h: 'float' = 10.0, clear: 'float' = 0.1, spacing: 'float' = 10.0) -> 'MeshList'
demo_dbore.usecase: Double-D motor and pot shafts, keyed hubs, and sockets that must transmit torque without a set screw.

demo_detent_pair.applications: Pan-tilt heads, adjustable arm joints, rotary selectors, and folding-leg locks that click positively into position.
demo_detent_pair.description: A spring-loaded plunger clicking into the notches of a dial, guided by a housing with a coil-spring pocket. Pan-tilt heads, adjustable arms, rotary selectors, and folding-leg locks.
demo_detent_pair.usecase: Pan-tilt heads, adjustable arm joints, rotary selectors, and folding-leg locks that click positively into position.

demo_differential_screw.applications: Fine-adjustment stages, micrometers, and slow linear motion from two slightly different pitches on one shaft.
demo_differential_screw.description: One shaft with two same-hand thread sections of slightly different pitch; travel per revolution is the pitch difference, giving micrometer-fine motion from coarse printed threads. Micrometer heads and optical fine-focus stages.
demo_differential_screw.doc: Differential screw with both nuts engaged on their thread sections.
demo_differential_screw.usecase: Fine-adjustment stages, micrometers, and slow linear motion from two slightly different pitches on one shaft.

demo_directed_holes.applications: Shower heads, spray nozzles, and multi-axis hole patterns aimed along arbitrary vectors.
demo_directed_holes.description: Eight vector-directed bores cut through a hemispherical dome.
demo_directed_holes.signature: demo_directed_holes(radius: 'float' = 16.0, n_holes: 'int' = 8, hole_r: 'float' = 2.2, hole_len: 'float' = 24.0, subdivisions: 'int' = 4, ray_scale: 'float' = 18.0, clip_w: 'float' = 40.0, clip_h: 'float' = 20.0) -> 'MeshList'
demo_directed_holes.usecase: Shower heads, spray nozzles, and multi-axis hole patterns aimed along arbitrary vectors.

demo_dog_clutch.applications: Motorcycle and gearbox dog rings, PTO engagements, and positive-lock couplings that must not slip once seated.
demo_dog_clutch.description: Two hubs with interleaved axial teeth that lock in torsion when pressed together and freewheel when withdrawn. Positive engagement, no slip once seated: gearbox dog rings and quick-change spindles.
demo_dog_clutch.usecase: Motorcycle and gearbox dog rings, PTO engagements, and positive-lock couplings that must not slip once seated.

demo_dog_slot_coupling.applications: Lost-motion couplings, indexed drives with backlash on purpose, and angular play between a dog and a slot.
demo_dog_slot_coupling.description: A downward collar dog riding in a boss arc slot to provide controlled angular lost motion.
demo_dog_slot_coupling.usecase: Lost-motion couplings, indexed drives with backlash on purpose, and angular play between a dog and a slot.

demo_double_cardan_joint.applications: Steering columns and industrial drives that cancel single-U-joint speed fluctuation with two Hooke joints phased 90 degrees.
demo_double_cardan_joint.description: Two Hooke joints in series with their intermediate yokes 90 degrees apart, so the second joint's speed error is the exact inverse of the first's and the output runs at constant velocity. The intermediate shaft between them still swings by the full single-joint fluctuation, which is the price this fix pays and the tripod does not. The centred double Cardan of truck driveshafts and steering columns.
demo_double_cardan_joint.usecase: Steering columns and industrial drives that cancel single-U-joint speed fluctuation with two Hooke joints phased 90 degrees.

demo_drag_chain.applications: Full cable-carrier runs protecting wires and hoses on moving axes of machines and 3D printers.
demo_drag_chain.description: An eight-link run of drag_chain_link posed with a straight section and a bend that curls the tail to its designed minimum bend radius, the classic U-turn a cable carrier makes guiding a wire or hose along a moving axis. Shows the link's stop actually working in an assembled run, not just in isolation.
demo_drag_chain.usecase: Full cable-carrier runs protecting wires and hoses on moving axes of machines and 3D printers; reverse_bend/s_bend_at pose RBR S-bend runs that snake between levels.

demo_drag_chain_link.applications: Cable carriers on CNC and robots; single link of an energy chain that flexes only one way.
demo_drag_chain_link.description: One link of a print-in-place cable-carrier (energy chain): a male pivot boss nests into the next link's female socket on a vertical (self-bridging) bore, with a keyway tab/groove pair that lets the joint articulate freely up to bend_deg but jams solid the other way, so a run of these curls one direction and stays rigid the other. An optional press-fit lid caps the cable trough.
demo_drag_chain_link.usecase: Cable carriers on CNC and robots; single link of an energy chain that flexes only one way (reverse_bend=True for RBR links that articulate both ways).

demo_eccentric_cam_clamp.applications: Quick-release workholding on mills and fixtures, bicycle seat and stem clamps, and over-centre cam locks on jigs.
demo_eccentric_cam_clamp.description: A rotary cam lock: a disc turning about a pivot offset from its centre, so the lift under the follower plate is the cam radius plus the eccentricity times the cosine of the handle angle. It is set to clamp a few degrees past top dead centre, where the clamped part's spring-back drives the handle into its stop instead of backing it out.
demo_eccentric_cam_clamp.usecase: Quick-release workholding on mills and fixtures, bicycle seat and stem clamps, and over-centre cam locks on jigs.

demo_eccentric_idler_mount.applications: Belt tension take-up on mills and printers: turn the eccentric to set belt preload without a sliding slot.
demo_eccentric_idler_mount.description: An eccentric take-up bushing carrying an idler pulley on its offset bore: turning the bushing with a hex key sweeps the idler through a circle equal to twice the eccentricity, setting belt tension, and a radial setscrew boss locks it in place. The same eccentric-bushing take-up used on printer belt idlers and chain tensioner sprockets.
demo_eccentric_idler_mount.usecase: Belt tension take-up on mills and printers: turn the eccentric to set belt preload without a sliding slot.

demo_escapement.applications: Longcase and printed clocks, metronomes, and any build that must release one tooth at a time under a pendulum or balance.
demo_escapement.description: A clock escapement: a forward-raked escape wheel and a pivoted anchor, flat parts posed with one pallet resting on a tooth tip; the style parameter selects recoil anchor or Graham deadbeat pallet faces. The visible tick of longcase and printed clock builds.
demo_escapement.usecase: Longcase and printed clocks, metronomes, and any build that must release one tooth at a time under a pendulum or balance.

demo_external_gear_pump.applications: Hydraulic power units, oil transfer pumps, and compact positive-displacement gear pumps for viscous fluids.
demo_external_gear_pump.description: Two meshing spur gears in a figure-eight bore carry fluid around the outside of each gear from inlet to outlet. The classic positive-displacement hydraulic pump; complements the internal gerotor already in the library.
demo_external_gear_pump.usecase: Hydraulic power units, oil transfer pumps, and compact positive-displacement gear pumps for viscous fluids.

demo_extrude_twist.applications: Twisted columns, augers, and decorative or functional solids swept with continuous rotation.
demo_extrude_twist.description: A three-lobed profile swept through one full turn over 30 mm.
demo_extrude_twist.signature: demo_extrude_twist(base_r: 'float' = 7.5, lobe_amp: 'float' = 2.0, lobe_count: 'int' = 3, height: 'float' = 30.0, turns_deg: 'float' = 360.0, count: 'int' = 96, z_samples: 'int' = 81) -> 'MeshList'
demo_extrude_twist.usecase: Twisted columns, augers, and decorative or functional solids swept with continuous rotation.

demo_face_cam.applications: Automotive and textile end cams, axial followers on face tracks, and compact lift programs normal to a disc face.
demo_face_cam.description: An axial face cam: the end face of a disc carries a raised track whose height follows a motion-law program, and a roller follower rides it for pure axial stroke. Complements plate (radial) and barrel (groove-on-drum) cams.
demo_face_cam.usecase: Automotive and textile end cams, axial followers on face tracks, and compact lift programs normal to a disc face.

demo_fastener_trio.applications: Assembly visualization: pan, socket, and countersunk screws with nuts and washers in CAD layouts.
demo_fastener_trio.description: Pan, socket, and countersunk screws with nut and washer stand-ins.
demo_fastener_trio.signature: demo_fastener_trio(size: 'float' = 3.0, length: 'float' = 14.0, spacing: 'float' = 14.0, nut_af: 'float' = 5.5, nut_h: 'float' = 2.6, nut_id: 'float' = 3.0, washer_od: 'float' = 8.0, washer_id: 'float' = 3.4, washer_t: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'MeshList'

demo_flat_worm_pair.applications: Bench-proven multi-start flat worms for FDM gearboxes and high-ratio printed drives that must actually mesh.
demo_flat_worm_pair.description: The bench-proven three-start input worm and lead-angle-matched wheel band at crossed axes.

demo_flexure_stage.applications: Optical and nanopositioning stages, vibration-isolated mounts, and printed straight-line stages without bearings.
demo_flexure_stage.description: A monolithic compound parallelogram flexure: an outer blade pair carries a secondary bar and an inner pair hangs back down from it to the motion stage, so the parasitic arc drop of one parallelogram cancels the other and the stage runs straight with no backlash or friction. Peak blade strain is computed and over-strained configurations are refused.
demo_flexure_stage.usecase: Optical and nanopositioning stages, vibration-isolated mounts, and printed straight-line stages without bearings.

demo_flywheel.applications: Punch presses, engines, spin-casters, and gyro demos that smooth shaft speed with a rim-heavy inertia wheel.
demo_flywheel.description: A rim-heavy energy-storage wheel, spoked or webbed, with mass, moment of inertia, and stored energy computed from the actual mesh. Punch presses, engines, spin-casters, and gyro demos.
demo_flywheel.usecase: Punch presses, engines, spin-casters, and gyro demos that smooth shaft speed with a rim-heavy inertia wheel.

demo_four_bar.applications: Walking-robot legs, windshield-wiper kinematics, folding-furniture hinges, and any hobby build that needs a guided coupler curve.
demo_four_bar.description: A flat-printable four-bar linkage kit with printed pivot pins, assembled by circle-circle position kinematics; the defaults are Hoecken straight-line proportions with an extended coupler tracer point. The canonical leg drive for hobby walking robots.
demo_four_bar.usecase: Walking-robot legs, windshield-wiper kinematics, folding-furniture hinges, and any hobby build that needs a guided coupler curve.

demo_freewheel_clutch.applications: Bicycle freehubs, starter motors, and overrunning clutches that drive one way and freewheel the other.
demo_freewheel_clutch.description: Cylindrical rollers between a smooth inner hub and ramped outer-ring pockets wedge instantly in one direction and release in the other, a silent one-way clutch with no tooth steps. Used in starter-motor bendix drives and conveyor backstops.
demo_freewheel_clutch.usecase: Bicycle freehubs, starter motors, and overrunning clutches that drive one way and freewheel the other.

demo_frustum.applications: Tapers, funnels, draft on molds, and stepped cones between two diameters.
demo_frustum.description: A truncated cone between two radii and two Z planes.
demo_frustum.usecase: Tapers, funnels, draft on molds, and stepped cones between two diameters.

demo_fusee.applications: Historical clock and watch fusees that equalize spring torque as the mainspring runs down.
demo_fusee.description: A conical spirally grooved fusee whose hyperbolic winding radius compensates a weakening mainspring to hold drive torque constant. The classic constant-torque heart of marine chronometers and English pocket watches.

demo_gasket_channel.applications: Enclosure lids and irregular flanges that seal with cord-stock gasket rather than a circular O-ring.
demo_gasket_channel.description: A cord-stock gasket groove that follows an arbitrary closed 2D path, here a rounded-rectangle lid, rather than only a circular pitch diameter, for enclosures and kidney-shaped lids an O-ring can't seal.
demo_gasket_channel.usecase: Enclosure lids and irregular flanges that seal with cord-stock gasket rather than a circular O-ring.

demo_geneva_pair.applications: Movie and film projectors, assembly turrets, indexing tables, and any station that needs dwell then a fixed step per revolution.
demo_geneva_pair.description: An external Geneva (Maltese cross) pair posed mid-engagement: the driver's crank pin indexes the slotted wheel one slot per revolution while its crescent-cut locking disc holds the wheel during dwell. The film-advance indexer of movie projectors and automated assembly turrets.
demo_geneva_pair.usecase: Movie and film projectors, assembly turrets, indexing tables, and any station that needs dwell then a fixed step per revolution.

demo_gerotor_pump.applications: Oil pumps in engines and transmissions, compact hydraulic power packs, and positive-displacement lubrication circuits.
demo_gerotor_pump.description: An internal-gear pump: a six-lobe trochoidal inner rotor running inside a seven-lobe outer rotor at an offset axis. The crescent chambers between the two open from zero on one side of the offset and close again on the other, carrying fluid from the inlet kidney port to the outlet. Displacement is measured off the real swept chamber polygons and lands in the metadata.
demo_gerotor_pump.usecase: Oil pumps in engines and transmissions, compact hydraulic power packs, and positive-displacement lubrication circuits.

demo_gimbal_rings.applications: Camera and sensor gimbals, gyroscope mounts, and nested rings that free two or three rotation axes.
demo_gimbal_rings.description: Nested rings hang from integral trunnion pins on alternating orthogonal axes and print flat as one piece: two rings are a Cardan suspension, three a full gimbal that keeps the centre level however the frame moves. Each ring radius is derived so its outer corners stay one clearance off the parent bore through the whole swing.
demo_gimbal_rings.usecase: Camera and sensor gimbals, gyroscope mounts, and nested rings that free two or three rotation axes.

demo_handwheel.applications: Manual leadscrew and valve adjustment on screw jacks, indexing tables, and machine axes; the crank variant drives winches.
demo_handwheel.description: A spoked handwheel for leadscrew and valve adjustment, here in the crank variant with a free-spinning captured grip. Manual drives for screw jacks, indexing tables, and winches.
demo_handwheel.usecase: Manual leadscrew and valve adjustment on screw jacks, indexing tables, and machine axes; the crank variant drives winches.

demo_harmonic_drive.applications: Cobot and industrial robot joints, pan-tilt heads, and anywhere you need huge ratio and near-zero backlash in a short package.
demo_harmonic_drive.description: A strain-wave gear: an elliptical wave generator deforms a thin flex spline so it meshes a rigid circular spline at two opposite zones. Ratio is -fs_teeth/(cs_teeth-fs_teeth); the default 50:48 pair is 24:1. The high-ratio compact reducer of robot joints.
demo_harmonic_drive.usecase: Cobot and industrial robot joints, pan-tilt heads, and anywhere you need huge ratio and near-zero backlash in a short package.

demo_heart_cam.applications: Chronograph hand reset (heart piece), sewing-machine take-up, and any cam that must return a pointer to a unique zero.
demo_heart_cam.description: A heart cam with symmetric linear rise and fall, giving constant-velocity follower motion and a unique angular reset position. Returns a chronograph seconds hand to zero.
demo_heart_cam.usecase: Chronograph hand reset (heart piece), sewing-machine take-up, and any cam that must return a pointer to a unique zero.

demo_helix_tube.applications: Spiral cable wraps, decorative helices, and swept tubes along a helical path.
demo_helix_tube.description: A capped solid wire swept through five turns with a radial-inward moving frame.
demo_helix_tube.usecase: Spiral cable wraps, decorative helices, and swept tubes along a helical path.

demo_herringbone_gear.applications: Quiet high-load gearboxes, marine and industrial herringbone pairs, and FDM gears that cancel axial thrust from helix angle.
demo_herringbone_gear.description: A double-helical involute gear whose mirrored tooth halves cancel axial thrust and self-center in mesh. The standard drive gear of printed extruders and quiet printed gearboxes.
demo_herringbone_gear.doc: Meshed herringbone pair: mirrored chevrons, phased with mesh_phase.
demo_herringbone_gear.usecase: Quiet high-load gearboxes, marine and industrial herringbone pairs, and FDM gears that cancel axial thrust from helix angle.

demo_hex_poly.applications: Nut and bolt blanks, hex columns, and across-flats hex stock for wrench-driven parts.
demo_hex_poly.description: A regular hexagon defined by across-flats width, shown as a solid.
demo_hex_poly.usecase: Nut and bolt blanks, hex columns, and across-flats hex stock for wrench-driven parts.

demo_hirth_coupling.applications: Machine-tool spindles, indexing tables, and face couplings that must locate torque and centerline with radial teeth.
demo_hirth_coupling.description: Two faces carrying radial V-teeth that seat into each other's valleys. Self-centring, zero-backlash torsion once preloaded: the standard machine-tool spindle and indexing-table face coupling.
demo_hirth_coupling.usecase: Machine-tool spindles, indexing tables, and face couplings that must locate torque and centerline with radial teeth.

demo_hose_barb.applications: Coolant and air tubing on printers and lab gear, barbed hose tails that grip soft tube without a clamp.
demo_hose_barb.description: A hose tail: a stack of sawtooth rings on a stop boss and a mounting flange. Each ring steps straight out to a crest wider than the tube bore and then tapers back, so the tube walks on over the taper and jams against the square shoulder coming off. The foot can also be an external printed thread.
demo_hose_barb.usecase: Coolant and air tubing on printers and lab gear, barbed hose tails that grip soft tube without a clamp.

demo_idler_pulley.applications: Belt path redirects on printers and conveyors, free-spinning pulleys that only change direction or take up slack.
demo_idler_pulley.description: A crowned idler wheel shown facing a GT2 timing pulley: the running surface bulges a fraction of a millimetre from edge to mid-width so a flat belt walks itself back to centre under tension, no flange required. The same function also builds a toothed idler by reusing the timing_pulley tooth profile, and can swap the plain bore for a 608/695/MR105 bearing pocket.
demo_idler_pulley.usecase: Belt path redirects on printers and conveyors, free-spinning pulleys that only change direction or take up slack.

demo_intermittent_gear_pair.applications: Mechanical counters, washing-machine timers, odometers, and digit-advance mechanisms that step once per input turn.
demo_intermittent_gear_pair.description: A mutilated-gear intermittent pair posed meshed: the driver keeps involute teeth on one arc with a plain locking segment, advancing the notch-locked driven gear one tooth group per revolution. The digit-advance scheme of mechanical counters and washing-machine timers.
demo_intermittent_gear_pair.usecase: Mechanical counters, washing-machine timers, odometers, and digit-advance mechanisms that step once per input turn.

demo_iris_diaphragm.applications: Camera and projector apertures, laser beam expanders, soft-robot grippers, and printed iris valves for light or air.
demo_iris_diaphragm.description: A print-in-place iris: leaves on their own pivot posts, each on its own Z layer, swung together by a drive ring whose radial slots pick up a pin on every leaf. Each leaf's inner edge is a circular arc struck about a point that walks off the axis as the leaf turns, so the opening stays round and shrinks from 24 mm to 6 mm over 6.6 degrees of ring travel.
demo_iris_diaphragm.usecase: Camera and projector apertures, laser beam expanders, soft-robot grippers, and printed iris valves for light or air.

demo_jaw_coupling.applications: Servo and stepper motor couplings, pump shafts, and general flexible jaw (Lovejoy-style) connections with a spider.
demo_jaw_coupling.description: Two jaw hubs interleave through a lobed elastomer spider (printed in TPU in practice) that carries torque in compression, damping vibration and failing safe if the spider dies. The Lovejoy-style motor-to-pump coupling of light industry.
demo_jaw_coupling.usecase: Servo and stepper motor couplings, pump shafts, and general flexible jaw (Lovejoy-style) connections with a spider.

demo_kerf_bend_cutter.applications: Living hinges, foldable enclosures, and kerf-bent panels that roll or twist from a flat print.
demo_kerf_bend_cutter.description: A cutter that turns a rigid flat slab into a bendable, twistable, or rollable one by slitting it with a staggered kerf pattern, the same trick as laser-kerfed plywood. Three slit layouts (straight lattice for single-axis bending or a living hinge, diagonal for torsion, spiral for a helical cylindrical wrap) all validate kerf width and bridge width against real FDM printability floors before cutting.
demo_kerf_bend_cutter.usecase: Living hinges, foldable enclosures, and kerf-bent panels that roll or twist from a flat print.

demo_kinematic_coupling.applications: Optical mounts, metrology fixtures, and any plate pair that must reseat to the same six-point pose every time.
demo_kinematic_coupling.description: An exactly constrained two-plate mount: three balls on the top plate drop into three seats on the base and touch at exactly six points, one per degree of freedom, so the top plate has one resting pose and returns to it every time. Maxwell cuts three vee grooves; Kelvin cuts a trihedral pit, a vee, and a flat. Shown book-flipped so both mating faces are visible.
demo_kinematic_coupling.usecase: Optical mounts, metrology fixtures, and any plate pair that must reseat to the same six-point pose every time.

demo_knuckle_hinge.applications: Print-in-place lids and doors, laptop-style hinges, and living hinges that need a hard stop at open or closed.
demo_knuckle_hinge.description: Interleaved barrels around one captive printed pin give a butt hinge that prints flat in a single piece and breaks free on the first swing. A full-width collar on each leaf ends in a radial flank through the pin axis, and the two flanks meet face to face to arrest the leaf at exactly stop_deg.
demo_knuckle_hinge.usecase: Print-in-place lids and doors, laptop-style hinges, and living hinges that need a hard stop at open or closed.

demo_knurl.applications: Thumb screws, adjustment knobs, and grip surfaces that need knurling without a lathe.
demo_knurl.description: A cylindrical thumb knob with printable vertical flutes.
demo_knurl.usecase: Thumb screws, adjustment knobs, and grip surfaces that need knurling without a lathe.

demo_labyrinth_seal.applications: Dust and splash seals on printed rotating shafts, non-contact comb seals where elastomer is unwanted.
demo_labyrinth_seal.description: A rotor comb and stator comb whose fins interleave around a shaft without ever touching, throttling flow across 2*teeth-1 stages through radial and axial clearance alone. Needs no elastomer and has no wear surface, so it is the seal to reach for on a printed rotating joint that only needs to keep out dust or splash.
demo_labyrinth_seal.usecase: Dust and splash seals on printed rotating shafts, non-contact comb seals where elastomer is unwanted.

demo_lazy_tongs.applications: Lazy-tongs riveters, scissor lifts, folding gates, and extendable booms that multiply a short squeeze into a long straight stroke.
demo_lazy_tongs.description: Nuremberg scissors: bars pinned at their centres and ends form a row of rhombs, so squeezing the frame end shoots the output yoke out along a straight line at the rhomb count times the stroke. Guide slots at both ends keep the travel on axis. The extension of a lazy-tongs riveter and of a folding gate.
demo_lazy_tongs.usecase: Lazy-tongs riveters, scissor lifts, folding gates, and extendable booms that multiply a short squeeze into a long straight stroke.

demo_lead_screw.applications: Vices, C-clamps, Z-axis stages, and press screws: trapezoidal power threads turning rotation into linear force.
demo_lead_screw.description: A trapezoidal (Tr) power screw and matching nut: flat crests print cleanly at power-screw leads where a sharp V thread would not. Vices, C-clamps, Z-axis stages, and press screws.
demo_lead_screw.usecase: Vices, C-clamps, Z-axis stages, and press screws: trapezoidal power threads turning rotation into linear force.

demo_leaf_spring.applications: Vehicle suspensions, clamp arms, and multi-leaf springs that carry load in bending.
demo_leaf_spring.description: A semi-elliptic multi-leaf spring: circular-arc leaves of decreasing length stacked on a common centre, the longest carrying a rolled eye at each end, held by a clamp band at the crown. Metadata reports the free camber, the travel to flat, and the rate from the classic n*E*b*t^3/(6*L^3) formula at the supplied modulus.
demo_leaf_spring.usecase: Vehicle suspensions, clamp arms, and multi-leaf springs that carry load in bending.

demo_lighten_grid.applications: Weight-saving panels on robots and drones, hex lattices that keep stiffness while cutting plastic.
demo_lighten_grid.description: A structural panel opened by a staggered hexagonal lattice.

demo_linear_way.applications: Machine-tool and 3D-printer linear guides, dovetail slides, and adjustable gibbed carriages.
demo_linear_way.description: A prismatic guideway that constrains a body to one axis: a dovetail, vee, or T-slot section swept along the travel direction, a carriage opened out by the running clearance, and a tapered gib whose axial position sets the preload. 45-degree ramps at both ends stop the travel and every inside corner carries a chip-relief groove.
demo_linear_way.usecase: Machine-tool and 3D-printer linear guides, dovetail slides, and adjustable gibbed carriages.

demo_loft.applications: Organic housings, fairings, and solids that blend unequal cross-sections along a path.
demo_loft.description: An organic solid joined through five equal-count point rings.
demo_loft.signature: demo_loft(r0: 'float' = 9.0, r1: 'float' = 8.0, r_mid: 'float' = 6.5, r3: 'float' = 7.5, r_top: 'float' = 5.0, height: 'float' = 30.0, ring_n: 'int' = 64, resolution: 'int' = 24) -> 'MeshList'
demo_loft.usecase: Organic housings, fairings, and solids that blend unequal cross-sections along a path.

demo_nut_slot.applications: Captive hex nuts in printed parts, T-nut slots, and any fastener seat that must not spin.
demo_nut_slot.description: A cut-away seated nut trap with its M3 nut stand-in.
demo_nut_slot.usecase: Captive hex nuts in printed parts, T-nut slots, and any fastener seat that must not spin.

demo_oldham_coupling.applications: Misaligned parallel shafts on pumps and encoders, and printed couplings that tolerate offset without side load.
demo_oldham_coupling.description: Two hubs with perpendicular diametral tongues drive a floating cross-slotted disc, transmitting constant-velocity rotation between parallel shafts with lateral offset. The anti-rotation coupling of scroll compressors and the stepper-to-leadscrew coupler of 3D printers.
demo_oldham_coupling.usecase: Misaligned parallel shafts on pumps and encoders, and printed couplings that tolerate offset without side load.

demo_oring_groove.applications: Face-seal glands on lids and flanges, AS568 O-ring seats designed for correct squeeze and fill.
demo_oring_groove.description: An O-ring gland cut into a flat face at a given pitch diameter. Groove width and depth are derived from the O-ring cross-section, target squeeze, and target gland fill rather than hardcoded, and the fill fraction is validated into the 70-85% band that keeps the ring from either leaking (too loose) or hydrolocking and extruding out of the joint (too tight).
demo_oring_groove.usecase: Face-seal glands on lids and flanges, AS568 O-ring seats designed for correct squeeze and fill.

demo_pantograph.applications: Engraving and sign-cutting pantographs, scale-copying arms, and any setup that traces a shape at a fixed scale ratio.
demo_pantograph.description: A parallelogram chain anchored at one fixed pivot: trace a shape with the stylus pin and the output pin draws the same shape scaled about the pivot. The ratio comes from the parallelogram closure, so it is exact at every position, and the achieved value is measured back off the posed geometry.

demo_peaucellier.applications: Straight-line guides without a slideway: instrument mechanisms, historical drafting machines, and teaching models of exact motion.
demo_peaucellier.description: Seven bars that draw a mathematically exact straight line: two anchor links and a rhombus form an inversor about the fixed pivot, and a crank holds the input point on a circle through that pivot, so the tracer runs a perfect line. The first exact straight-line linkage, and still the reference case for guiding motion without a slideway.

demo_peristaltic_pump_head.applications: Lab and medical dosing pumps, food-safe fluid transfer, and any pump that must never touch the fluid with gears or seals.
demo_peristaltic_pump_head.description: A peristaltic pump head: three posts on a rotor pinch a silicone tube against a circular race, so each post drags a sealed slug of fluid round the wrap. The two tube slots leave the race tangentially, which is what stops a post shearing the tube where it peels off the wall. The tubing is a bought consumable, not a printed part.
demo_peristaltic_pump_head.usecase: Lab and medical dosing pumps, food-safe fluid transfer, and any pump that must never touch the fluid with gears or seals.

demo_pins_and_posts.applications: PCB standoffs, locating pins, screw bosses, and alignment features between mating plastic parts.
demo_pins_and_posts.description: A bored screw boss beside a locating pin and blind socket block.

demo_pip_ratchet.applications: Print-in-place freewheels, one-way knobs, and socket adapters that click when turning the drive way only.
demo_pip_ratchet.description: Three captive rigid pawls, each reseated by a printed accordion spring, inside a matching undercut ring.

demo_plain_bushing.applications: Journal bearings in printed machines, flanged sleeve bushings for shafts that only need sliding support.
demo_plain_bushing.description: A flanged plain bushing: a plastic sleeve that a steel shaft turns directly inside, with the running fit set explicitly by printing the bore at bore_d plus clear. Axial relief grooves hold grease and give swarf somewhere to go; the flange takes the light axial load a journal bearing can carry. The low-precision, high-reliability choice wherever a rolling bearing is overkill.
demo_plain_bushing.usecase: Journal bearings in printed machines, flanged sleeve bushings for shafts that only need sliding support.

demo_planet_stage.applications: Robot gearboxes, cordless-tool reducers, and multi-stage planetary transmissions with a fixed ring.
demo_planet_stage.description: An assembled 12:9:30 top-loading planetary stage with three planets and a downward hex-output carrier.
demo_planet_stage.usecase: Robot gearboxes, cordless-tool reducers, and multi-stage planetary transmissions with a fixed ring.

demo_plate_cam.applications: Model engines and automata valve timing, packaging-machine motion programs, and any radial cam that must follow a prescribed lift law.
demo_plate_cam.description: A radial plate cam synthesized from dwell, linear, SHM, and cycloidal motion-law segments, roller-compensated and extruded with a hub and D-flat bore. Programs the valve timing of a model engine or an automaton's motion.
demo_plate_cam.usecase: Model engines and automata valve timing, packaging-machine motion programs, and any radial cam that must follow a prescribed lift law.

demo_press_lid.applications: Battery and electronics boxes, snap-fit instrument lids, and friction-plug covers that press closed without screws.
demo_press_lid.description: A hollow box and its friction-plug lid in an exploded pose.
demo_press_lid.signature: demo_press_lid(box_w: 'float' = 34.0, box_d: 'float' = 28.0, box_h: 'float' = 14.0, wall: 'float' = 2.0, lid_lift: 'float' = 23.0, lid_clear_x: 'float' = 30.0, lid_clear_y: 'float' = 24.0) -> 'MeshList'
demo_press_lid.usecase: Battery and electronics boxes, snap-fit instrument lids, and friction-plug covers that press closed without screws.

demo_printed_ball_bearing.applications: Fully printed radial bearings for light-duty rollers, demo models, and places steel bearings will not fit the budget.
demo_printed_ball_bearing.description: A radial ball bearing that prints in one piece, already assembled: inner race, spacer cage, balls, outer race. Each raceway is a ball-radius groove truncated at 45 degrees of latitude so no race wall ever overhangs past the FDM limit and nothing bridges over the balls, and each ball has its bottom cap cut off at 45 degrees so its first layer is a flat disc. The shoulders left by that truncation are narrower than the ball, which is what keeps it captured.
demo_printed_ball_bearing.usecase: Fully printed radial bearings for light-duty rollers, demo models, and places steel bearings will not fit the budget.

demo_printed_worm.applications: Fully printed worm reducers for robots and turntables, when metal worms are overkill and self-locking is welcome.
demo_printed_worm.description: A journalled printed worm with runout threads, keyed bore, thrust collars, and radial set-screw hole.
demo_printed_worm.usecase: Fully printed worm reducers for robots and turntables, when metal worms are overkill and self-locking is welcome.

demo_push_pin.applications: Barbed press-fit pins for plastics, axles that push in and stay, and printed rivets with a lead-in.
demo_push_pin.description: A barbed printed press pin with a conical lead-in tip.
demo_push_pin.usecase: Barbed press-fit pins for plastics, axles that push in and stay, and printed rivets with a lead-in.

demo_quick_return.applications: Metal shapers and slotters, packing machines, and press feeders where the return stroke should run faster than the working stroke.
demo_quick_return.description: A crank and slotted-lever quick-return whose pivot offset sweeps toward the Whitworth configuration; the working:return time ratio is exposed as mechanism metadata. The classic ram drive of metal shaping machines.
demo_quick_return.usecase: Metal shapers and slotters, packing machines, and press feeders where the return stroke should run faster than the working stroke.

demo_rack_2d.applications: Linear stages, rack-and-pinion steering, and CNC axes that convert rotation into straight travel along a pitch line.
demo_rack_2d.description: Eight pressure-angle trapezoidal teeth at pi times module circular pitch, extruded thin for display.
demo_rack_2d.usecase: Linear stages, rack-and-pinion steering, and CNC axes that convert rotation into straight travel along a pitch line.

demo_rack_pinion.applications: Steering racks, CNC and plotter axes, camera sliders, and linear stages driven by a spur pinion.
demo_rack_pinion.description: An involute spur pinion posed in mesh with a straight rack. One pinion turn advances the rack by pi*module*teeth along the pitch line. Steering racks, linear stages, and CNC axes.
demo_rack_pinion.usecase: Steering racks, CNC and plotter axes, camera sliders, and linear stages driven by a spur pinion.

demo_ratchet_wheel_pawl.applications: Winch drums, come-alongs, windlasses, and webbing tensioners that need a serviceable, high-torque one-way drive.
demo_ratchet_wheel_pawl.description: The canonical bolt-on ratchet: an external sawtooth wheel and a separate pivoted pawl with a leaf or coil spring. Winch drums, come-alongs, windlasses, and webbing tensioners.
demo_ratchet_wheel_pawl.usecase: Winch drums, come-alongs, windlasses, and webbing tensioners that need a serviceable, high-torque one-way drive.

demo_rbox.applications: Enclosure walls and buttons with rounded corners that print cleanly and feel finished.
demo_rbox.description: A clean enclosure block with rounded vertical corners.
demo_rbox.usecase: Enclosure walls and buttons with rounded corners that print cleanly and feel finished.

demo_repeatable_dock.applications: Tool changers, probe docks, and magnetic kinematic mounts that need preload so they do not fall apart when tipped.
demo_repeatable_dock.description: A kinematic coupling plus the preload that keeps it closed, since a bare coupling resists nothing in the lift-off direction and falls apart when tipped. A disc magnet on a central boss or a central cap screw pulls along the coupling axis only, so the preload never becomes a seventh contact, and a bolt circle phased between the seats mounts both halves.
demo_repeatable_dock.usecase: Tool changers, probe docks, and magnetic kinematic mounts that need preload so they do not fall apart when tipped.

demo_revolved_gable_cavity.applications: Annular chambers under self-supporting roofs, plumbing voids, and lightened rings.
demo_revolved_gable_cavity.description: A cut-away annular chamber beneath a 45 degree gable roof.

demo_revolved_gable_cavity.usecase: Annular chambers under self-supporting roofs, plumbing voids, and lightened rings.

demo_ring_gear.applications: Planetary ring gears, internal mesh housings, and turntable drives that run a pinion inside an annulus.
demo_ring_gear.description: An internal (annular) involute gear: the teeth are cut inward from a rim, so the tip circle is inside the pitch circle and the root circle outside it. The fixed ring of a planetary gearbox, a strain-wave drive's circular spline, and an involute spline socket are all this part.
demo_ring_gear.doc: Internal involute ring gear: teeth cut inward from an annular rim.
demo_ring_gear.usecase: Planetary ring gears, internal mesh housings, and turntable drives that run a pinion inside an annulus.

demo_ring_gear_mesh.applications: Epicyclic stages, slewing drives, and internal gear pairs where pinion and ring turn the same way.
demo_ring_gear_mesh.description: A pinion posed in mesh inside an internal ring gear. The ring flanks are generated, not drawn: the mating pinion is rolled through the conjugate internal motion and the swept region is subtracted from the blank. Internal pairs turn the same way and sit at a centre distance equal to the DIFFERENCE of the pitch radii, which is why they pack a high ratio into a small envelope.
demo_ring_gear_mesh.doc: Pinion running inside an internal ring gear, posed in mesh.
demo_ring_gear_mesh.usecase: Epicyclic stages, slewing drives, and internal gear pairs where pinion and ring turn the same way.

demo_roller_chain.applications: Conveyors, motorcycles, and machine drives that wrap a roller chain around a sprocket.
demo_roller_chain.description: A sprocket built by gears.roller_sprocket_2d with a run of bare rollers wrapped around 200 degrees of its pitch circle, each seated in its tooth gap with running clearance by construction: the geometric proof that roller_chain_link's roller diameter and pitch actually mate with the sprocket function.
demo_roller_chain.usecase: Conveyors, motorcycles, and machine drives that wrap a roller chain around a sprocket.

demo_roller_chain_link.applications: Bicycle and industrial roller-chain pitches, printable chain segments matched to a sprocket.
demo_roller_chain_link.description: One pitch segment of a bush roller chain: inner and outer link plates, a bushing pressed between the inner plates, a roller that spins free around the bushing, and the pin that runs through it all. Sized to seat directly in a sprocket built by gears.roller_sprocket_2d at the same pitch and roller diameter.
demo_roller_chain_link.usecase: Bicycle and industrial roller-chain pitches, printable chain segments matched to a sprocket.

demo_roller_follower.applications: Valve lifters, pump diaphragm drives, and automata: the pivoted roller lever that rides plate, heart, and snail cams.
demo_roller_follower.description: A pivoted lever carrying a roller (plain, or a bought 625 bearing in a press pocket) that rides a plate, heart, or snail cam. Valve lifters, pump drives, and automata.
demo_roller_follower.usecase: Valve lifters, pump diaphragm drives, and automata: the pivoted roller lever that rides plate, heart, and snail cams.

left_out_notes:
Mechanisms deliberately left out, and why. Each was measured, not assumed.
# The recurring reason is the period: a loop can only be seamless if every body
# comes back, and a body's own rotational symmetry is what decides how soon.
# Where the finest symmetry is 1-fold -- a D-flat bore, an eccentric cam, a
# disc whose lobe count is coprime with its hole count -- nothing short of a
# whole turn of that body will do, and the input has to turn as many times as
# the ratio demands.
#
#   demo_worm              The demo poses worm and wheel for display, already
#                          interpenetrating by 93 mm^3, and the pair has no
#                          measurable conjugate contact (overlap stays 0 across
#                          a +/-8 degree wheel band), so the drive sense cannot
#                          be recovered from the geometry -- only asserted.
#   demo_cycloidal_drive   Animated: cycloidal_pose + 11 input turns (3960 deg)
#                          for the default 12-pin / 6-hole layout. Listed in
#                          ANIMATE. Shorter closed tracks fail because lobes
#                          and holes are coprime.
#   demo_planet_stage      The sun's D-flat bore leaves it 1-fold symmetric
#                          (measured), so the sun needs a whole turn; the
#                          carrier runs at 2/7 sun and is 3-fold, so it needs
#                          seven of them. Shortest repeating picture is 2520
#                          deg of sun, and the sun's 30 deg tooth pitch then
#                          needs 252 frames. Feasible, just not worth it.
#   intermittent_gear_pair mechlib exposes no engagement relation (unlike
#                          geneva_wheel_angle / escapement_pose). Rotating the
#                          pair at a continuous ratio would drive the locking
#                          segment through the notch: an invented motion.
#   escapement             Animated: escapement_pose gives the stepped wheel
#                          + swinging anchor law; listed in ANIMATE.
#   oldham_coupling,       Their POSE laws (the disc's 2-omega orbit, the
#   universal_joint,       Cardan tangent relation) are textbook but are not in
#   double_cardan_joint    the module, so baking them would mean authoring one.
#                          v0.8.0 added cv_velocity_ratio, which is the SPEED
#                          relation only: it still does not place a spider.
